segments.he: מַתְנִי' נְבִיא הַשֶּׁקֶר הַמִּתְנַבֵּא מַה שֶּׁלֹּא שָׁמַע וּמַה שֶּׁלֹּא נֶאֱמַר לוֹ מִיתָתוֹ בִּידֵי אָדָם
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «The false prophet» mentioned in the Torah includes «one who prophesies that which he did not hear» from God «and» one who prophesies «that which was not said to him,» even if it was said to another prophet. In those cases, «his execution is at the hand of man,» through strangulation imposed by the court.

segments.he: אֲבָל הַכּוֹבֵשׁ אֶת נְבוּאָתוֹ וְהַמְוַותֵּר עַל דִּבְרֵי נָבִיא וְנָבִיא שֶׁעָבַר עַל דִּבְרֵי עַצְמוֹ מִיתָתוֹ בִּידֵי שָׁמַיִם שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר אָנֹכִי אֶדְרֹשׁ מֵעִמּוֹ
segments.en: «But» with regard to «one who suppresses his prophecy» because he does not want to share it with the public, «and one who» contemptuously «forgoes the statement of a prophet» and refuses to heed it, «and a prophet who violated his own statement» and failed to perform that which he was commanded to do, «his death is at the hand of Heaven, as it is stated:» “And it shall come to pass, that whosoever shall not hearken unto My words that he shall speak in My name, «I will exact it of him”» (Deuteronomy 18:19).

segments.he: הַמִּתְנַבֵּא בְּשֵׁם עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה וְאוֹמֵר כָּךְ אָמְרָה עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה אֲפִילּוּ כִּוֵּון אֶת הַהֲלָכָה לְטַמֵּא אֶת הַטָּמֵא וּלְטַהֵר אֶת הַטָּהוֹר
segments.en: «One who prophesies in the name of idol worship and says: This» is what the «idol said, even» if «he approximated the» correct «halakha» in the name of the idol «to deem ritually impure that which is ritually impure and to deem ritually pure that which is ritually pure,» is executed by strangulation.

segments.he: הַבָּא עַל אֵשֶׁת אִישׁ כֵּיוָן שֶׁנִּכְנְסָה לִרְשׁוּת הַבַּעַל לְנִשּׂוּאִין אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁלֹּא נִבְעֲלָה הַבָּא עָלֶיהָ הֲרֵי זֶה בְּחֶנֶק
segments.en: In the case of «one who engages in intercourse with a married woman once she entered her husband’s domain for» the purposes of «marriage, even if» the marriage was not yet consummated, as «she did not» yet «engage in intercourse» with him, «one who engages in intercourse with her is» executed «by strangulation.» Before marriage, one who engages in intercourse with her is liable to be executed by stoning.

segments.he: וְזוֹמְמֵי בַּת כֹּהֵן וּבוֹעֲלָהּ שֶׁכׇּל הַמּוּזַמִּין מַקְדִּימִין לְאוֹתָהּ מִיתָה חוּץ מִזּוֹמְמֵי בַּת כֹּהֵן וּבוֹעֲלָהּ
segments.en: «And conspiring» witnesses who testified that «the daughter of a priest» committed adultery are executed by strangulation, even though were she guilty, she would be executed by burning. «And her paramour» is also executed by strangulation, as in any case where one engages in intercourse with a married woman. «As all» those «who are rendered conspiring witnesses are led to» their deaths via «the same» mode of «execution» with which they conspired to have their victim executed, «except for conspiring» witnesses who testified that «the daughter of a priest and her paramour» committed adultery. In that case, although the priest’s daughter who commits adultery is executed by burning, the conspiring witnesses who sought to have her executed are executed by strangulation, as is the paramour whom they also conspired to have executed.

moves.summary: False prophet is executed by man
Suppressing prophecy etc. is death by Heaven
Prophesying in an idol's name, even correctly
Intercourse with a married woman after nisuin is strangulation
Conspirators against a priest's daughter and her paramour are strangled

edges.about: death at the hand of Heaven for suppressing prophecy, ignoring a prophet, or a prophet violating his own word

positions.claim: prophesying what one did not hear or was not told is death by man; suppressing prophecy etc. is death by Heaven
